recipe.title: Chicken Fried Rice

steps.text: Sauce & chicken: Mix Sauce in a bowl. Pour 2 tsp over chicken, toss to coat, then set aside for 10 minutes.
steps.label: Marinate chicken

steps.text: Egg: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or skillet over medium heat. Add egg and scramble until just cooked (still a touch wet) then remove.
steps.label: Cook egg
steps.doneness_cue: until just cooked (still a touch wet)

steps.text: Fried Rice: Turn heat up to high, add remaining 1/2 tbsp oil and bacon into same skillet. Cook for 1 minute or so until fat starts to melt, then add onion and garlic.
steps.label: Start bacon

steps.text: Cook until bacon is light golden - about 1 1/2 minutes.
steps.label: Cook bacon

steps.text: Add vegetables (still frozen is fine). Cook for 1 minute.
steps.label: Cook vegetables

steps.text: Add chicken and cook until it changes from pink to white - about 1 1/2 minutes.
steps.label: Cook chicken
steps.doneness_cue: until it changes from pink to white

steps.text: Add rice and Sauce ingredients. Cook for 1 1/2 minutes, stirring consantly.
steps.label: Combine rice

steps.text: Add egg and green onion, toss through to disperse then remove from heat.
steps.label: Finish rice

notes: Method and timings taken from the linked recipetineats.com JSON-LD HowToStep data. Ingredient names and prep notes are grounded to the recipeIngredient lines; parenthetical notes were moved to prep_note where they appeared on the same line.
Produced one component label: step 1 produces "scrambled egg" which is consumed in the finish step.
Attention cue for step 6 preserves the original misspelling exactly: "stirring consantly".
